newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GE set to buy AEG unit in South Africa.
newsitem.headline: GE set to buy AEG unit in South Africa.

text.p: U.S. based General Electric (GE) said on Friday it would buy the low voltage interests of AEG in South Africa.
It said the acquisition was in line with the restructuring of AEG parent group Daimler Benz AG.

GE said the purchase was a continuation of its investment drive into South Africa and would expand its local operations and customer base while also being a springboard to marketing its products in sub-saharan Africa.
GE already operates 12 business divisions in South Africa which develop power systems, medical systems, aircraft engines, information systems, appliances, lighting and industrial products.
